title: Micro Rally (альфа)
compatibilityNote: Alpha: handheld controls, audio and sustained performance await player feedback.
notes: Four-stage solo Woodland Challenge with the full Nordschleife final; Rust Pit arena and 900x700 m Deadwater Battle Royale. Up to 16 cars, adjustable bots, independent suspension, five tire surfaces, heat-limited unlimited base gun, manual gears and haptics. Five camera views including windshield; shared SDK profile driver with updated outfits and expressions. English interface. Multiplayer uses TrainerOS Lobby; protocol micro-rally.8 requires matching updates. Network racing remains in Valley; network cup is not included. Handheld performance and full gameplay acceptance remain pending. Flip2 uses OpenGL.
